learning_objective: 🌟 Discover super fun games that children all over India love to play, learn teamwork, and celebrate our amazing culture!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Kho-Kho is a super fast chasing game! You sit in a row facing opposite sides. When your teammate taps your back and shouts KHO, you jump up and run to catch the other team.
Take a deep breath and chant Kabaddi, Kabaddi without stopping! Cross the line, tag your friends, and rush back safely to your side to score big points.
Traditional games are the most fun when everyone plays by the rules. Always be honest, cheer for your friends, and shake hands after the game is over.

fun_activity.title: 🙈 Classic Hide and Seek
fun_activity.instructions: Gather your family or friends! One person closes their eyes and counts to 20 while everyone else finds a clever hiding spot. Ready or not, here I come!

quick_recap: ⭐ Local games like Kho-Kho and Kabaddi make us fast, strong, and smart.
⭐ Holding your breath and chanting builds super lung power.
⭐ Always play fair and respect the rules to make sure everyone has fun.
